name: ApplySent
description: Search jobs that fit your résumé, preview each tailored application and apply on the employer's own form (Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby and more), with a receipt of what was sent. Every application needs your approval; there is no bulk auto-apply over MCP. Remote server with OAuth sign-in.
author: ApplySent

tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search jobs that match the user's résumé and filters, best match first.

tools.name: get_job_from_link
tools.description: Read a job from its posting link.

tools.name: preview_tailored_resume
tools.description: Preview the résumé tailored for a job.

tools.name: preview_application
tools.description: Show what applying to one job would send; sends nothing; returns a single-use confirmation token.

tools.name: apply_to_job
tools.description: Send one application, only after the user said yes to its preview; needs the confirmation token.

tools.name: queue_application_for_review
tools.description: Prepare an application for review in ApplySent; sends nothing.

tools.name: cancel_application
tools.description: Stop an application before sending starts.

tools.name: answer_question
tools.description: Answer an employer question only the user can answer.

tools.name: list_applications
tools.description: List applications with status and receipts.

tools.name: get_application_receipt
tools.description: Show what was sent for an application.

tools.name: get_profile_status
tools.description: Check whether the profile is ready to apply.
